readerCopy.body: You may finally find the words for something that has been difficult to explain without making it larger than it is. Mercury trine Chiron can make a sensitive conversation more precise, especially when the difference between what happened and what you assumed it meant has been hard to separate. A direct question, a carefully written message, or one useful detail can clear up more than another hour of replaying the entire history. Say what still matters now.
